'''Gwethh''' was a type of [[Spice tea/Legends|spice tea]] that was popular on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The term was also a popular name among [[Gender/Legends|female]] Ithorians.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Gwethh.png|thumb|right|alt=A pixelated transparent bowl with bubbling green contents.|Gwethh in ''Star Wars: Tiny Death Star'']]
Gwethh was first mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2003]] supplement for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]] and published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="GCG" /> The [[Tea/Legends|tea]] then appeared in the [[2013]] non-[[canon]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Tiny Death Star]]''. In the game, the tea was depicted as a bubbling [[Color/Legends|green]] liquid and could be produced on the "Ithorian Food" food level of a [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]], costing two [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and taking twenty-five [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] to make without upgrades to the food level. Once the level was fully upgraded, the tea could be prepared in just eighteen minutes.<ref name="TinyDS">''[[Star Wars: Tiny Death Star]]''</ref>
